entries.title: Spectral dimension of a wire network
entries.venue: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General
entries.note: 用扩散热核的拉普拉斯本征态密度定义谱维数；钢丝网络的谱维数独立于局部结构。

entries.title: Critical spectral dimensionalities of random walks and phase transitions on fractals
entries.venue: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General
entries.note: 把临界空间维度推广为分形上的临界谱维度；随机行走与相变存在不同的临界谱维数。

entries.title: On the recurrence of simple random walks on some fractals
entries.note: 预 Sierpinski 垫片在所有维度上常返；预 Sierpinski 地毯 d=2 常返、d>=3 暂态。

entries.title: Resistance dimension, random walk dimension and fractal dimension
entries.note: 推广 Telcs 定理：随机行走维度、分形维度、电阻维度的关系。

entries.title: Diffusion and spectral dimension on Eden tree
entries.venue: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General
entries.note: 计算 Eden 树上随机行走谱，检验标度关系 d_s = 2 d_f / d_w；有限尺寸导致的 crossover。

entries.title: Spectral Dimension and Random Walks on the Two Dimensional Uniform Spanning Tree
entries.note: 证明 Z^2 上均匀生成树的谱维数几乎必然为 16/13；转移概率、位移与逃逸时间估计。

entries.title: Random walk on random planar maps: Spectral dimension, resistance and displacement
entries.note: 一类由 mating-of-trees 编码的随机平面地图（含 UIPT）谱维数几乎必然等于 2；返回概率 n^{-1+o(1)}。

entries.authors: Marek Biskup, Jian Ding, Subhajit Goswami
entries.title: Return Probability and Recurrence for the Random Walk Driven by Two-Dimensional Gaussian Free Field
entries.note: 二维高斯自由场随机导抗驱动的随机行走常返且返回概率 T^{-1+o(1)}，即谱维数 2。

entries.title: Some Results for Range of Random Walk on Graph with Spectral Dimension Two
entries.note: 谱维数为二的图上简单随机行走范围的强大数律；不含空间齐性假设。

entries.title: Ahlfors regular conformal dimension of metrics on infinite graphs and spectral dimension of the associated random walks
entries.note: 无限图上的 Ahlfors 正则保形维数与 p-能量临界指数一致，并与谱维数建立关系。

entries.authors: Ana P. Millán, Joaquín J. Torres, Ginestra Bianconi
entries.title: Synchronization in network geometries with finite spectral dimension
entries.note: 谱维数决定 Kuramoto 同步：同步相在谱维数高于 4 才热力学稳定，相位牵引需谱维数大于 2；在可调谱维数的复网络流形上数值验证。

entries.title: Network geometry with flavor: From complexity to quantum geometry
entries.note: 引入 Network Geometry with Flavor (NGF)，可在任意维度 d 生成复网络流形，结构强烈依赖维度 d；是可调谱维数的几何网络模型。

entries.title: Simplicial complexes: higher-order spectral dimension and dynamics
entries.note: NGF 单纯复形上上/下高阶 Laplacian 的谱维数随阶数增加；高阶扩散返回型分布依赖阶数 n。

entries.authors: Fatihcan M. Atay, Türker Bıyıkoğlu, Jürgen Jost
entries.title: Network synchronization: Spectral versus statistical properties
entries.note: 同步性不能由统计性质推断；小局部结构变化敏感影响与同步相关特征值，而统计性质基本不变。

entries.authors: David Gfeller, Paolo De Los Rios
entries.title: Spectral Coarse Graining and Synchronization in Oscillator Networks
entries.note: 凝聚节点保留拉普拉斯矩阵关键动力学方面；为简化振荡网络提供谱粗粒化方法。

entries.authors: Francisco A. Rodrigues, Thomas Peron, Peng Ji, Jürgen Kurths
entries.title: The Kuramoto model in complex networks
entries.note: 复杂网络上 Kuramoto 同步的综述：网络模式对局部与全局相位动力学的影响、解析手段与开放问题。

entries.title: Convergence Rates in Distributed Consensus and Averaging
entries.venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
entries.note: 固定图与动态拓扑下分布式平均/共识的收敛速度算法与多项式时间收敛界。

entries.authors: Pierre-Alexandre Bliman, Angelia Nedić, Asuman Ozdaglar
entries.title: Rate of Convergence for Consensus with Delays
entries.venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
entries.note: 时滞下异步共识的收敛速率界，为系统参数（延迟界、通信间隔界）的显式函数。

entries.authors: Eduardo Montijano, J.I. Montijano, Carlos Sagüés
entries.title: Fast distributed algebraic connectivity estimation in large scale networks
entries.note: 分布式二分法估计固定无向通信图的代数连通度（拉普拉斯第二小特征值），通信量随网络尺寸不变。

entries.title: Optimization of convergence rate via algebraic connectivity
entries.note: 代数连通度刻画共识过程的指数收敛速率下界；加边加速共识的贪心策略与广义代数连通度。
